item.title: Collingdale police chief on administrative leave amid work hour dispute
item.description: Shanee Mitchell, the first female African American police chief in Collingdale, is currently on administrative leave. The decision comes amid controversy over her work schedule. item.description: A gas leak at Coatesville Area Intermediate High School led to an evacuation and early dismissal for students. item.title: Man struck and killed by vehicle in Southwest Philly: police
item.description: A man was struck and killed by a vehicle on Woodland Avenue, prompting an investigation by the Philadelphia Police. The incident occurred at 7:26 p.m. on the 5100 block of Woodland Avenue. Police say the man struck by the vehicle was pronounced dead at 7:47 p.m. by the PFD Medic Unit. The driver involved remained at the scene. The Crash Investigation Division is leading the efforts to understand what happened.
